title: Ninaivirukkum Varai
desc: A slum dweller falls in love with a wealthy woman who treats him like a friend. However, when he learns the truth about the man she is going to marry, he sets out to stop her wedding.

title: Manaivi Ready
desc: Radha, a young man, visits a village to attend the wedding of his friend's sister. However, when the groom runs away, he is forced to marry the devastated bride.

title: Amarkalam
desc: Vasu, an unruly man, fights with Mohana, the daughter of a police officer, over a movie reel. Thereafter, the two fall in love but face unforeseen problems while they try to unite.

title: Aalukkoru Aasai
desc: Arivazhagan plans on leading a happy life by choosing an independent educated girl as his partner. However, his orthodox grandparents trick him into marrying an illiterate woman.

title: Maayandi Kudumbatthar
desc: A property dispute ruins the relationship between two brothers, Mayandi and Virumandi. Matters become worse when Mayandi dies and Virumandi's son seeks revenge on his family.
